title: Clear space / minimum size
slide_intent: Teach designers to measure clearance and minimum print size separately. A seal needs enough open space around it and enough scale for its lettering to read.
strategic_value: The trust can preserve the seal’s silhouette and internal detail as its printed applications vary in size.
demonstration: A large seal at center diagrams its clear-space unit from the letterforms to the outer circle. At right, a small specimen measures the minimum full logo height at 14 mm in print.
practical_value: Apply the seal’s own spacing unit to its surrounding area, then check its full printed height against the 14 mm minimum.

content_islands.name: Measurement notes
content_islands.spec: Set separate Clear space and Minimum size notes beneath the page title in the left column.

content_islands.name: Clearance diagram
content_islands.spec: Center an enlarged seal inside concentric guides. Mark the interval taken from the artwork and extend it around the seal.

content_islands.name: Print-size specimen
content_islands.spec: Separate the small right-hand example with a vertical rule. Draw the height dimension beside the mark and place the print minimum below.
